card.name: Up-titration and tapering of doses
card.fires_on: The 't' or 'pt' piece in 'up-titration' or 'up-titrate' in dosing instructions. It also fires on the word 'Taper' starting a sentence.

modes.label: Up-titration
modes.description: The 't' after 'up-' in up-titrate or up-titration, when slow dose increases are described.
modes.example: Monitor closely and up<<-t>>itrate slowly in patients with severe coronary

modes.label: Taper at sentence start
modes.description: The word Taper opening a sentence about stopping a drug gradually.
modes.example: Advise patients of the potential to relapse to illicit drug use following discontinuation of opioid agonist/partial agonist medication-assisted treatment.<< T>>aper patients to reduce the occurrence of withdrawal

card.writes: The promoted pieces do not form a clear theme, so it adds no clear output effect.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a dosing instruction where a dose is raised or lowered gradually, as in up-titrate or taper.
